events.text:
Build verified: seven-cell honeycomb, fully covered and edge-finished.

* **Seven-cell honeycomb work surface:** center piece:0,0,0;full plus six neighbours piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:-1,1,0;full, piece:0,-1,0;full, piece:0,1,0;full, piece:1,-1,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full forming complete honeycomb.
* **Covered on top:** all seven cells have top covers cover:-1,0,0;full;top through cover:1,0,0;full;top including center cover:0,0,0;full;top.
* **Every open outside edge finished with caps:** 18 caps placed on all exposed perimeter edges (3 per outer cell), 0 cap sockets remaining - configurator confirms all outside edges are finished. Examples cap:-1,0,0;*;150, cap:1,0,0;*;30 etc covering 18 bearings.
* Check_build: ok true, meshClash clear. Only warning LOOSE_BODY (joint bolts optional for locking, not required by brief).

Honeycomb layout, top surface and edge finishing as briefed are complete.
